name.description: Name for the VLAN interface, e.g. 'guest'

gateway.description: Usable router address inside the subnet, excluded from the DHCP pool

bridge.description: Bridge to put the VLAN on

tagged_ports.description: Comma-separated verified tagged ports; the bridge/CPU is included once automatically

dhcp.description: Create a DHCP server + pool for the segment

dhcp_range.description: Single start-end IPv4 range excluding gateway/network/broadcast. Required outside /24; /24 defaults to .10–.254

internet.description: Add egress-scoped IPv4 masquerade (requires wan_interface); not a firewall allow. Set false to reuse existing NAT

wan_interface.description: Verified egress interface for new masquerade. Required when internet=true; never inferred

isolate_from.description: Subnets this segment must NOT reach, e.g. ['192.168.1.0/24']

isolation_before.description: Current enabled forward rule .id from a fresh read; insert drops before this reviewed rule, not after broad accepts. Required with isolate_from
